messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API queue for eu-west saturated. GPU pool 'eu-west-inference' at 100% alloc, provisioner failing to create new nodes (rate-limited). Current backlog ~11.8k requests. p95 9.6s, p99 28.2s, increased 10x in last 7m. Creating incident channel and paging oncall.

sara_oncall: Ack. I'm on it — will gather triage and coordinate mitigations. Paging infra and SRE.

mike_infra: looking at autoscaler/provisioner. Seeing lots of 429s from cloud API when creating instances. Provisioner logs show: 
```
2026-03-17T18:02:03Z provisioner ERROR createInstance: 429 QuotaExceeded: Requested cores > quota
2026-03-17T18:02:04Z provisioner WARN retrying backoff 120s
```


devon_ml: can we fallback to smaller quantized variant for hosted-api routes? redwood-small-q8 is compatible with current runtime and drops GPU mem by ~45%. That will reduce queue pressure quickly.

anya_support: Support is seeing customer reports of 504s for two mid-market customers (acct: AcmeAnalytics, BrightRetail). They're seeing timeouts on high-throughput endpoints. Need ETA for mitigation to update them.

leo_sre: We have two levers: 1) force-fall back production traffic to smaller model for non-SLA tiers, 2) re-route a subset of tenant traffic to the Dedicated pool (if allowed by routing policy). I'll start routing non-critical tenants to dedicateds if they opt in.

sara_oncall: Plan A: enable model-fallback for free/low-tier traffic now. Plan B: throttle and enable safe-rate-limit for anonymous/free routes. Plan C: escalate quota to cloud (longer). Who can flip fallback?

mike_infra: I can flip the fallback toggle. Running command now: 
```
redwoodctl rollout traffic-policy set --route "hosted.api.generate" --fallback-model redwood-small-q8 --criteria "tier!=enterprise" --dry-run=false
```

mike_infra: Done. Propagating. Watch backlog and p95.

incident-bot: NOTE: Traffic-policy change applied by mike_infra at 18:06:12Z. Rollout=instant.

devon_ml: good call. Also enabling aggressive KV prefix cache for repeated prefixes (config flag). Should see token cost + latency improvement on repeated prompts.

mike_infra: autoscaler still failing to create nodes due to region quota hard limit. Opening emergency request with cloud provider, but ETA for quota raise unknown (often 30-90m).

anya_support: Customers pinged — AcmeAnalytics on hold (they're throttled). BrightRetail asked for mitigation ETA ~20m. I'll tell them we initiated fallbacks and are throttling non-critical traffic.

leo_sre: Re-routing 3 low-risk tenants to dedicated-eu-pool now (manually pinned). This reduces pressure by ~12% on the shared pool.

sara_oncall: Good. Next: set emergency rate-limit rule for anonymous and web-playground to 20r/s globally. mike, can you apply?

mike_infra: Applying rate-limit rule: 
```
redwoodctl config set --path /ratelimit/global/anonymous --value "20r/s"
```

mike_infra: Rule applied.

incident-bot: SYSTEM: New rate-limit activated by mike_infra at 18:11:03Z.

sara_oncall: Backlog dropping from 11.8k -> 7.2k in 6m after fallback+rate-limit. p95 down to 3.4s, p99 down to 11.0s. We're still above SLOs for enterprise customers.

devon_ml: Can we do targeted canary: pin enterprise customers to higher-priority capacity? That will keep them within SLA while we sort quotas.

leo_sre: Can do for two customers affected. Pinned AcmeAnalytics & BrightRetail to dedicated-boost lanes. Confirmed traffic prioritized.

anya_support: Both customers confirm requests are being accepted again; AcmeAnalytics reports reduced 504s. Communicating status.

mike_infra: Cloud has acknowledged quota request but marked as "manual review". No guaranteed ETA. Opening follow-up with sales/partner to push if needed.

sara_oncall: OK. Current status: shared GPU pool saturated, autoscaler blocked by provider quota. Immediate mitigations: model-fallback + aggressive cache + global rate-limits + manual tenant pinning to dedicateds. Load down ~40% from peak. No total customer outage. Severity: P2 (customer degradation).

leo_sre: I'm handing off oncall to devon_ml in 30m. I'll prepare notes.

devon_ml: Taking oncall. Will monitor backlog and verify autoscaler once quota increases or if we can provision in alternate region.

sara_oncall: Create incident ticket and assign postmortem. action items: 1) evaluate quota thresholds, 2) add automated fallback runbook, 3) improve cross-tenant isolation to prevent single campaign blasts. Anyone want to own 1?

mike_infra: I'll own 1 (quota thresholds + preemptive provisioning).

devon_ml: I'll own 2 (automate model-fallback + canary rules).

leo_sre: I'll own 3 (isolation improvements).

anya_support: I'll draft customer comms and timeline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: id=INC-20260317-4821 severity=P2 created_by=sara_oncall. Handoff: devon_ml (oncall).

sara_oncall: Thanks team. I'll keep watch for the next 20m then step out. Please update the incident thread for any major changes. :thumbsup:
